item.description: Even if you weren't much of a planner in 2025, the new year is your chance to start on a better foot. item.description: Canada’s resale housing market is expected to regain some forward momentum in 2026, following a stop-start recovery that took shape over the back half of last year, according to the latest forecast from the Canadian Real Estate Association (CREA).
